introHtml: Embroidery on tissues and wipes adds a tactile, premium feel that screen printing can't match. Perfect for corporate gift sets or hospitality suites, embroidered logo tissues elevate your brand with a subtle, lasting impression. Choose from soft cotton or microfiber wipes in bulk quantities, with your logo stitched in up to six thread colors. Ideal for hotels, spas, or event swag bags where quality matters.
